name: AC Compressor Repair & Replacement
tagline: The heart of the AC, handled honestly
headline: Get an Honest Verdict Before You Replace Your AC
summary: A dead compressor is not always a dead AC. Often the fault is a ₹599 capacitor or relay, and many compressors carry 5-10 year brand warranties you can still claim. We test first, give you a written verdict, and replace only when the numbers genuinely favour it over a new unit.

symptoms.title: Fan runs, no cooling
symptoms.description: The indoor blower works but the air stays warm because the compressor never kicks in — often a starting component, not the compressor itself.

symptoms.title: Clicking from the outdoor unit
symptoms.description: A repeated click-hum-silence cycle means the compressor is trying to start and failing, a classic relay or capacitor fault.

symptoms.title: MCB trips when AC starts
symptoms.description: A locked rotor or shorted winding pulls heavy current the moment the outdoor unit engages, tripping the breaker.

symptoms.title: Runs, then cuts out
symptoms.description: The compressor overheats and trips its thermal overload — common in Chennai when 40°C terrace heat meets a dust-choked condenser.

symptoms.title: Bills up, cooling down
symptoms.description: A worn compressor draws more current for less cooling, and the jump shows on your EB bill before the AC fails outright.

symptoms.title: Advised to buy new
symptoms.description: If a technician has condemned your AC on sight, a written second opinion from ₹299 is cheaper than a ₹35,000 mistake.

faqs.question: My AC is not cooling at all. Is the compressor definitely gone?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily, and this is the most expensive assumption in AC repair. A dead capacitor, failed relay or low gas produces the same symptom for a fraction of the cost. We test the compressor windings and starting circuit before giving any verdict, so you never pay compressor prices for a capacitor problem.

faqs.question: Is my compressor still covered by the brand warranty?
faqs.answer: Quite possibly. Daikin, LG, Voltas, Blue Star, Hitachi and most major brands give 5-10 year warranties on the compressor alone, well beyond the one-year unit warranty. Share your purchase invoice or serial number and we will verify coverage and help raise the claim, so the brand pays for the part and you pay only for labour and gas.

faqs.question: Should I replace the compressor or just buy a new AC?
faqs.answer: It depends on the unit's age, gas type and the condition of its coils, and we put both numbers in writing so you can decide. For a unit under seven or eight years with healthy coils, replacement usually costs a fraction of a comparable new AC. For an older R22 unit with corroded coils, we will tell you plainly that the money is better spent on a new machine.

faqs.question: What does compressor replacement cost in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Our labour for a full replacement starts from ₹4,999, covering removal, brazing, nitrogen flushing and deep vacuuming. The compressor itself is billed at brand invoice price and varies with tonnage and model, and a fresh R32 gas charge runs ₹2,500-3,500. You get the complete figure in writing before we start.

faqs.question: Why did my compressor fail, and will the new one last?
faqs.answer: In Chennai the usual killers are voltage fluctuation, running on low gas and condensers choked by dust and coastal salt air. We identify the actual cause during diagnosis and address it — often a stabiliser recommendation or a condenser clean — before commissioning the new compressor. That is the difference between a replacement that lasts and one that fails the same way next summer.
